content: Very interesting, but maybe a little difficult to solve in reverse mode.
The mode is "without statement" so now you can see it but not in real game

You shouldn't give the goal, in-out & constraints then :D
Too bad I saw them :)

Yes, clashes with only Reverse mode enabled should either have an effectively empty statement or display a warning upfront.

Goal
* Please add at the beginning:
<<This clash is in Reverse mode only.>>

Stub generator
* Please change "n" to "A".

* Please change "N" to "B".

* Please add a write statement.

Cases
* Validator 1: Please change the input so that [[A]] < [[B]] and the GCD is 1, similar to Test 1.

* Please add Test 5 and Validator 5 where [[A]] is a multiple of [[B]] and [[A]] ≠ [[B]].

* Please add Test 6 and Validator 6 where [[B]] is a multiple of [[A]] and [[A]] ≠ [[B]].

* Please add Test 7 and Validator 7 where [[A]] = [[B]].

* Please add Test 8 and Validator 8 where [[A]] > [[B]] and the GCD is 1.

* Please add Test 9 and Validator 9 where [[A]] > [[B]] and the GCD is greater than 1.

* Please add Test 10 and Validator 10 where [[A]] > [[B]] and the GCD is greater than 19.

Thanks.
I think it's fair for @N3l to mention what they think as a reviewer, even when the review isn't the real clash itself.

Oh, don't get me wrong. I actually think this clash is pretty cool. Simple and effective. It fits the clash genre.

I'll admit I prefer solving puzzles to just validating them. So I found it a little frustrating to have read the instructions before I even realized it was a puzzle without instructions! :D

EDIT: Upvoted!
